title: Adobe security advisory (AV26-1039)
description: As of October 13, 2026, Adobe is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Adobe Bridge
	Prior to or equal to 16.0.7

Adobe Bridge (LTS)
	Prior to or equal to 15.1.8

Adobe Dimension
	Prior to or equal to 4.1.8

Adobe FrameMaker 2022
	Prior to or equal to 17.0.9.866

Adobe FrameMaker 2026
	Prior to or equal to 18.0.0.206

Adobe Photoshop 2026
	Prior to or equal to 27.10

Adobe Photoshop 2025
	Prior to or equal to 26.11.7

Adobe Substance 3D Designer
	Prior to or equal to 16.05

Adobe Substance 3D Sampler
	Prior to or equal to 6.0.3

Adobe Substance 3D Stager
	Prior to or equal to 3.1.8
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
